## deploy/release-notes-6.25.3-646f.md
1 # Release notes: payments-api build 6.25.3-646f
2 
3 Previous build: 6.24.1. Defaults below override repository config files.
4 
5 - clients: default `clients.tax-engine.timeout_ms` lowered from 2500 to 800 (fail fast)
6 - cache: default `cache.ttl_s` unchanged (120)
7 - build: container base image refreshed
8 - deps: json serializer upgraded
9 - tracing: sampling rate default 1% (unchanged)
10 - metrics: db pool gauges renamed to `db_pool_*`
11 - deps: http client library upgraded to a patch release
12 - metrics: new histogram for cache hit latency
13 - api: `/v1/status` returns build id
14 - feature flags: `ff-legacy-export` removed (was 0%)
15 - docs: runbook links updated
16 - retry: idempotent GETs retried once on connect errors
17 - db: default connection pool `db.pool.max_size` lowered from 48 to 10 to fit the shared-db connection quota
18 - batching: max batch size default 200 (unchanged)
19 - scheduler: cron jitter added to cleanup job
20 - locale: currency formatting fixes
21 - security: TLS session tickets rotated hourly
## ops/oncall-notes.md
1 # On-call notes - payments-api incident 2031-03-06
2 
3 Informal running notes. Not reviewed; may be out of date.
4 
5 - 08:29 ingress-a 5xx for payments-api since build 6.25.3-646f rolled out. Many tax-engine timeouts.
6 - 08:39 Suspect the tax-engine timeout default change in 6.25.3-646f; asking for a mitigation.
